title: Escaping the hustle and bustle of the city with amazing views and beautiful swims in the sea.
text: This was one of our holiday highlights. We went out on the boat for 2 hours to escape the hustle and bustle of Barcelona. It was so hot and there was very little shade on the beach, so being on the boat was lovely as it had shade and a lovely sea breeze. The kids and adults spent an hour diving/ jumping off the boat into the lovely clear water looking back at the amazing landscape of Barcelona. We even had the pleasure of watching the Americas cup boats practicing for the upcoming races.  Our captain was really lovely and welcoming. The kids enjoyed playing thier music on the boat. title: Amazing! A Barcelona must!
text:
Enjoy the gorgeous skyline of Barcelona in a sailboat! Mariana greets you like family at the dock and it's all great from that moment on. A beautiful glass of cava, Spanish snacks, and excellent ambiance. Whether you want to relax in the quiet or laugh and have great discussions with Mariana, this experience is a must do! I'll definitely plan to contact Mariana when I return to Barcelona with my family from Canada. 

Thank you Mariana for a fantastic afternoon! Wow! 

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED to everyone!
author: Carlosbcna
